title: Media God Mobile
message: Media God Mobile 1.0.8 improves 4K/HDR playback on phones and tablets with Media3 1.11.0 plus device-aware UHD capability checks. It now considers 4K/8K size, frame rate, 10-bit/Main10 and Dolby Vision profile hints before choosing Media3 or the compatibility decoder, while newer Android devices can use their stronger HEVC, AV1, VP9 and HDR hardware directly.
